slot-34ef1e37-b1af-4a50-a0bb-52f7fdfe5b1.quote_span: Between March 2025 and May 2026, the CDC's overall workforce has decreased by 30%, stretching across divisions, offices and job fields, according to a new report from the American Federation of Government Employees, a union representing CDC workers.

slot-de7cea81-c80f-41c5-93f8-06511b106b5.quote_span: Over the course of 14 months, an estimated 3,539 "separations" took place within the agency, accounting for layoffs, retirements and those who quit.

slot-de7cea81-c80f-41c5-93f8-06511b106b5.checkable_against: AFGE report on CDC workforce separations

edges.label: contradicts
edges.reason: The NEW occurrence reports the starting headcount (12,705) and the EXISTING occurrence reports the final headcount (9,166). These are two different values for the workforce headcount at different times (start vs end of the period), making them incompatible as a single value for the slot. They originate from the same source (USA Today quoting the union).

changes.sentence: On 2026-10-01, USA Today reported “It brought the estimated workforce from 12,705 employees to just 9,166, the union said.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “from 12,705 employees”.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, USA Today reported “It brought the estimated workforce from 12,705 employees to just 9,166, the union said.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “from 12,705 employees”.
